# GeminiExact external experiment

`m5b-gemini-exact.hlsl` is an externally authored experimental source supplied
for DVT2-M5B-GEMINI-EXACT. It is retained byte-for-byte; its SHA-256 is
`0ebc86c1c595f03a671ddd63f25f882ae2ce70606c025a875627456038b44755`.

The file's own comments are preserved as supplied. Repository provenance is
external HLSL, not SDSL-V generated source. It remains experimental and must
not replace SerialCanonical. `m5b-gemini-exact.spv` and
`m5b-gemini-exact.spvasm` are the static DXC `vulkan1.3` / SPIR-V 1.6 artifacts
validated for the Vulkan 1.4 runtime contract.
